subject: [PATCH v2 5/5] btrfs: pre-allocate delayed dir index for non-overwrite rename

2026-08-04.patch_summary: This patch improves the Btrfs file system by pre-allocating a delayed directory index before performing non-overwrite renames, allowing for early detection of ENOMEM errors and preventing potential data corruption. The patch introduces a new function to pre-allocate the delayed dir index and modifies existing functions to handle this new parameter. It also preserves the current behavior for overwrite renames by continuing with the transaction even if an ENOMEM error is encountered.
